newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares higher, tracking Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares higher, tracking Wall Street.

text.p: Chilean stocks were trading broadly higher at midday, with the market seen tracking Wall Street but with investors paying close attention to local interest rates, said traders.
"The bourse will depend very much on whether domestic interest rates rise further," said one trader.
Long-term interest rates rose on Monday in reaction to the government's 1997 budget, which the bolsa considered expansive, he said.
The selective IPSA index gained 0.04 percent at mid-morning to 98.57.
The general IGPA index was up 0.13 percent at 5,421.93.
Chilean-issued American Depositary Receipts opened lower but were mostly higher by mid-morning, mirroring Wall Street's recovery, said dealers.
Gainers included power utilities Enersis and Chilgener, which rose 0.39 percent to 258-1/2 pesos and 0.21 percent to 2,425 pesos, respectively.
